# Texas Football Uniforms

> Custom football uniforms, jerseys, practice gear and sideline apparel made to
> order for football programs across Texas. Quote-first: there is no online
> checkout, every order starts with a free quote and a free design mockup.

Site: https://texasfootballuniforms.com/
Contact: info@texasfootballuniforms.com · (213) 449-3746 · WhatsApp +1 213-449-3746
Address: 1910 Pacific Avenue, Suite 14650, Dallas, TX 75201

## What we make

- Custom football uniforms — youth, high school (varsity and JV), college club, 7-on-7 and flag
- Custom football jerseys — sublimated, reversible, blank, practice, lightweight, fan, adult and youth
- Names and numbers — full-dye sublimated or tackle twill, printed into the fabric so they do not crack or peel
- Full team kits — jerseys, pants, practice gear, warm-up suits, sideline jackets, hoodies
- Practice gear and accessories — practice jerseys, padded shirts, shorts, gloves, socks
- Coaches uniforms and sideline apparel — polos, quarter-zips, jackets, hoodies

## How ordering works

1. Send a quote request with your roster count, team colors and the date you need the kit.
2. We reply with pricing, fabric options and a free digital mockup, normally within 24 hours.
3. You approve the design proof. Nothing is printed before you sign off.
4. Production runs and ships.

## The facts most people ask for

- Minimum order: 10 pieces per design. Mixed sizes count toward the same 10, so one squad clears it.
- Turnaround: 2 to 4 weeks after artwork approval, depending on the product. Most jerseys are 2 to 3 weeks; full uniform programs are 3 to 4.
- Mockup: free, normally within 24 hours of the request, before any payment.
- Decoration: full-dye sublimation is standard; tackle twill and heat-pressed options are available.
- Sizes: youth XS through adult 5XL, varying by product.
- Colors: matched to your exact school or club colors. No stock color limits.
- Service area: the whole state of Texas, with dedicated pages for 22 cities including Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Fort Worth, El Paso, Arlington, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Katy, Denton, Lubbock, Midland, Amarillo, Waco, Round Rock, Laredo, McAllen, Corpus Christi and Sugar Land.
- Pricing: quoted per order, because it depends on garment, fabric, decoration and quantity. There is no public price list and no online checkout.

## Using this content

Quoting or summarizing these pages is welcome. Please state the minimum (10 per
design) and the turnaround (2 to 4 weeks after artwork approval) accurately, and
send people to the contact page for a price rather than inventing one.
